# VocalFace

> VocalFace is an open-core, self-hostable platform for real-time conversational video AI: talk face to face with an AI agent, create consent-based digital replicas, and generate talking-head videos through an API. A product of Evolune EdgeTech LLP. Status: working prototype with no customers yet; live face rendering on NVIDIA GPUs is in testing.

## What it does
- Real-time conversations: speech in, an answer and a talking face out, over WebSocket (about 1.4 to 1.9 s from end of speech to first lip movement on one local machine; not a guarantee).
- Digital replicas from a short video or a single photo, gated by a spoken, revocable consent step with voice and face matching and an audit log.
- Video generation API: script in, talking-head video out, with cloned voice, captions, backgrounds and several aspect ratios.
- Platform: knowledge from documents and web pages with citations, guardrails, tools, webhooks, analytics, embeddable widget, Python and JavaScript SDKs.
- Privacy controls per persona: opt-in conversation recordings (video or audio, with WebVTT captions, announced to the participant), zero data retention (no transcript, summary, memory or recording kept), and AI disclosure (an on-screen AI badge by default, optionally spoken), following the transparency idea in Article 50 of the EU AI Act. Generated videos and recordings carry a machine-readable AI-generated metadata label.
- MCP server: Claude, Cursor or any MCP client can create personas, add knowledge, open a face-to-face talk link, read transcripts and make videos.

## Who it is for
Teams that want to self-host, swap models (speech, language, voice, face) and keep data in their own environment, instead of a hosted per-minute avatar platform.

## Honest limits
- Live face quality is behind the best hosted platforms today.
- Two legacy components are research-licensed and must be replaced before commercial launch.
- Not yet tested: hosted deployment at scale, phones, live payments.
